scope: Unadopted coordinated head anatomy correctness and candid complete-head craft assessment
qualification: Scoped prototype correctness/evidence PASS; complete adult-person craft remains unmet, not production or full appearance acceptance

findings.description: Clay reveals stronger orbital basin/malar/nasal/perioral structure and three-quarter depth; it still has a compressed rigid mouth, abrupt chin-to-neck transition, narrow flat ear attachments and mannequin-like surfaces. These remain visible at both 96x120 and native 240x300.
Shaded hair remains a cap with sparse wire details and beard coverage remains painted with a hard rear boundary. The coordinated face improvement does not resolve complete-head quality.

Separate exposed eye patches have finite forward/outward normals and shared saved coordinate transforms. Blink is shader aperture masking; eyelids do not physically move. Clay suppresses pigment and grooming deliberately and is not another saved person.
